Griffin Asset Management Inc acquired 5,520 shares as Anadarko Petro Corp (APC)’s stock rose 11.90%. The Griffin Asset Management Inc holds 26,172 shares with $1.58 million value, up from 20,652 last quarter. Anadarko Petro Corp now has $35.94 billion valuation.
